As a punk kid of the 80's, I recall feeling that the PMRC and the Christian Coalition were these clueless conservative, religious zealots. Fast forward a few years, and I realize Democratic candidate for vice president Al Gore's wife is Tipper Gore. How could a Democrat be so regressive? How could I have been so naive? At this point I abandoned both parties and became a Libertarian. I realized that neither political party represented my interests, but still callowly believed that the system was still working, and capable of reform if things ever got truly out of wack. Fast forward another few years, and I just can't believe that the regressive left is operating out in the open like the new Inquisition. What would Jello Biafra and all of those other so-called liberals who fought against the PMRC and the forces for censorship think? If I am thankful of one thing, it is that Libertarian is now a household word, and that those possessing even a shred of discernment realize that there is no difference between the party on the left and the party on the right. Sure there are still a lot of people that identify with each party who staunchly believe there is a difference, but the fact that there is so much support for candidates like Sanders and Trump, that the mainstream media absolutely abhors and are doing everything possible to undermine, to me shows real promise. I think if anything positive comes out of this election it will be that a wider demographic of Americans will finally understand just how broken our political system is. Yeah I know people always joke about corruption and politicians and all of that palaver, but I think that politicking is finally starting to affect the previously silent majority, who thought they were immune to the effects of wayward policies and broken promises, and this majority still possesses enough power to turn the tide now that their eyes have been opened.
